import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
data = json.loads((repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-allocation-v1/summary.json').read_text())
traces = json.loads((repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-training-trace-v1.json').read_text())
dest = repo / 'docs/images/spectral-loss-allocation-v1'
dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
groups = {(x['domain'],x['ADC_only']):x for x in data['groups']}
all_adc = groups['all-balanced-domains',True]['parameter_gradient_squared_norm_sum']
all_noisy = groups['all-balanced-domains',False]['parameter_gradient_squared_norm_sum']
methods = ['legacy_total','post_total','focused_post_total','floor16_total']
labels = ['Current 2 DN','Post-output 2 DN','Peak-weighted post 2 DN','Current 16 DN']
adc_share = np.array([all_adc[k]/(all_adc[k]+all_noisy[k])*100 for k in methods])
params = np.load(repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-allocation-v1/parameter-gradients-v1.npz')['gradients'].astype('float64')
names = json.loads((repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-allocation-v1/parameter-result-v1.json').read_text())['parameter_vector_names']
rows = json.loads((repo / 'docs/results/spectral-loss-allocation-v1/parameter-result-v1.json').read_text())['parameter_rows']
noisy_mask = np.array([not (x['noise']['shot']==x['noise']['read']==0) for x in rows])
base = params[:,names.index('legacy_total')]
floor16 = params[:,names.index('floor16_total')]
rel = np.linalg.norm(base-floor16,axis=1)/np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(base,axis=1),1e-30)
fig,axes = plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4),layout='constrained')
x=np.arange(4)
axes[0].bar(x,adc_share,color='#aa5b47',label='ADC-only (15 batches)')
axes[0].bar(x,100-adc_share,bottom=adc_share,color='#3e7f96',label='Noisy (85 batches)')
axes[0].set_xticks(x,labels,rotation=20,ha='right')
axes[0].set_ylim(0,125);axes[0].set_ylabel('Share of squared initial\nparameter-gradient norms (%)')
axes[0].legend(loc='upper right',fontsize=8);axes[0].set_title('Same 100 cached training batches; zero head')
for i,v in enumerate(adc_share):axes[0].text(i,v/2,f'{v:.3f}%',ha='center',va='center',color='white',fontsize=9)
ds=['mesh','weak','flat','mixed','photo']
for delta,method,color,label in [(-.19,'legacy_total','#7b588c','Current 2 DN'),(.19,'floor16_total','#3e7f96','Current 16 DN')]:
 vals=[math.sqrt(groups[d,True]['parameter_gradient_squared_norm_sum'][method]) for d in ds]
 axes[1].bar(np.arange(5)+delta,vals,width=.38,color=color,label=label)
axes[1].set_xticks(np.arange(5),ds);axes[1].set_yscale('log');axes[1].set_ylabel('ADC aggregate gradient norm\n[sqrt(sum of squared batch norms)]')
axes[1].set_title('Largest change is ADC flat/photo supervision');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
for ax in axes:ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
fig.savefig(dest/'initial-parameter-allocation.svg')
fig.savefig(dest/'initial-parameter-allocation.png',dpi=140)
plt.close(fig)
